steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Kid!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That's enough. Don't push yourself—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No... Master Vogelweide... Look at your hand...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: This isn't the first time. I'm used to it.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It's over. Your strength is beyond my expectations. It was just enough to tide my anger...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You too are a descendant. I shall not take your life, but you will get out of my way.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: So you've got your heart set on dueling Margaret, huh?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Wrong. I am merely continuing a fight that was cut short.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You're stubborn and... mad. What are you looking for anyway? What is it that you actually want?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You do not understand...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Like hell I would. For that so-called tradition of yours, you gave up your whole life and everything ahead of you! It's all pointless!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Did I need you to give my life meaning?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I just don't want to see you stay on this path of insanity forever. The 'Khaganquest' is a coming-of-age tradition followed by a handful of tribes. Doesn't that make you still a child?!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Gah! I am done with you. Out of the way.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Over my dead body!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: —You will regret this, old man!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Maria, what are you doing?! You're hurt—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: This is my first time to see you so worked up, Nightzmora...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: The shield of a knight is meant to protect people. That's what my sister told me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You said my conviction was borrowed. I've got nothing to say about that.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But if I'm going to be scared to walk even well-lit roads, then there's really no point in the knighthood anymore!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: How dare you spout that nonsense about knights—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Sorry, but I'm not a knight anymore. I just want to protect my sister—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I can't let a psycho like you get in her way!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Arts...? It's... Hm?
A ray of light shines off the blood on Maria's face.
Fragile and insignificant. It's true. If he gave it his all, the Nightzmora could easily have strangled the pegasus to death.
He is confident of that.
Yet... why does the blood on her face... have this radiant, golden shine?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Is it the light of the Arts turning it gold?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: A pegasus whose name is bound to go down in history... yet so frail... Is it a mere coincidence?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Master Vogelweide, go back without me... I'll hold him here.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Drop the act, kid. He'll kill you—!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'll stop him!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh...? Why are you turning around...?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...Pegasus.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You cannot grow stronger on the conviction of others. Not unless you truly believe in it.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: And you do not.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Dedication and sacrifice.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: These virtues border on self-destruction... and you possess them at birth. You taught me a lesson, pegasus, descendant.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Perhaps...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...No, never mind.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Tell the Radiant Knight that my bout with her has not yet ended. I am merely putting it on hold.
Perhaps? Perhaps what?
Perhaps I would have made the same decision if I had been raised in the same environment as you?
Never allow yourself to be so weak, Tola.
Never!

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The Radiant Knight, the Blood Knight... The Major has really heated up in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If we go by points and nothing else, the finals should long have been in reach of the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Doesn't that make you happy?

options: If only the K.G.C.C. would let Nearl take the crown.
After the Infected incident, will the people accept that?
Nearl's greatest challenge has only just begun.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You're right...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But even if the General Chamber is scheming something, I'm sure you and the Adeptus will help Nearl overcome.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That said, is the K.G.C.C. really the problem...? They're definitely not ones to do any work themselves. Instead, they prefer to sow the seeds... and wait for them to sprout.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Many will voice their gripes...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hehe... but that also happened when the Blood Knight first came along.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But who still remembers any of that after the Blood Knight took his trophy and the money came raining down?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: They have short memories, Doctor. No matter who ends up winning, as long as they speak on the Infected's behalf, it'll all work out fine.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Kazimierz loves its champions.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You mean... the Blood Knight? No, you wouldn't say something so skin-deep...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Whatever's the case, I believe you and Nearl will overcome.

options: How are Amiya and the medic operators doing?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: They're giving the Infected knights checkups and treatment, just as always.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Rhodes Island is plenty efficient. I can see why the Grand Knight trusts you so much.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That said... I'm here right with you, and you haven't shown even a little bit of care for me.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That makes me kind of sad.

options: You're right. I should thank you for all your help.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What are you thanking me for, specifically?

options: For being a diligent bodyguard.
For giving us all this invaluable intel while we have our hands tied.
Uhh... for chatting with me and helping me kill time?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'm just doing my job. I was given my orders, and I would go through fire and water to fulfill them.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I've only told you what the Grand Knight permitted me to say.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'd love to accept your thanks, but it was her who truly helped Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Oh... so our conversations are just a way to pass the time to you?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hehe, but in that case, I'll keep talking to you all you want.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: So, how will you thank me, Doctor?

options: Pretend to take a walk outside so you can take a break and go shopping?
What are you into? Rhodes Island's got all kinds of people.
Anything you want.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Hehe... That sounds wonderful. I've always wanted to be a model, just once.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I may wear all this armor all the time, but I'm still a girl. I got tired of this outfit a long time ago.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That said... I didn't really have the right to think about something like this, in the past.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What I'm into...?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I've never thought about it before... What do normal Kazimierzian girls like? Food? Makeup? Oh... Let's not talk about knight stuff.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Well... as for outfits... All this armor does dampen my spirits every now and then.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Though a campaign knight like me doesn't really get much chance to wear regular clothes, either.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Doctor... do you know what you're saying? 'Anything you want' is pretty much the last thing you'd want to say when you're being interrogated.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Most of us hand our decision-making power away, probably because we find obnoxious to have to make decisions... but sometimes... the one we give that power may have some unexpected ideas.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Well, then, Doctor... Would you lean back, please?

options: Uh, sure.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Close your eyes, okay? I wouldn't want anything to happen to them...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: And then...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Doctor, don't open your eyes.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If you see an Armorless assassin's face, I'm afraid you won't be leaving Kazimierz alive.

options: I can't let you bear all the risks.
I've got to at least know what's going on, no?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You're not just a regular campaign knight, are you?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The Armorless Union doesn't hold the patent on assassination, you know?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Don't move, or I'll cut your throat open.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Now that won't do. I can't let you put the Doctor's life in danger, even if it costs me my own.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: It's just some foreign company... Is this one really worth giving your life for, knight—Hm?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The barcode on your arm... You're a purchased slave. Why so loyal to an outsider?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Unfortunately, my desire to protect the Doctor comes from the bottom of my heart.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I see... The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi arranged for a lackey like you to follow Rhodes Island around. They planned to use Rhodes Island to investigate Area 0 right from the start.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Don't make our relationship sound so exploitative.

options: That's right. If you gotta say it, we exploit each other.
This is what you call a win-win situation.
As long as we get along, am I right?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So you are Rhodes Island's 'Doctor.' There's supposed to be a Cautus girl around too...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'm not into hurting kids. Bumping you off should do the trick, right?

options: Too bad. Amiya's Rhodes Island's true leader.
You really shouldn't underestimate Amiya though.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Doctor, go on without me. I'll hold her here. Take Miss Amiya and leave this place. Look for someone from the Adeptus—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'm not here alone.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Armorless Union already has you surrounded... You're not walking out of here.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It's okay, Doctor... As long as I'm here, I—

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: —Doctor?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Shielding your own bodyguard? What's the idea? You'll give your life for someone else?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Aww, so cute... I've got a job to do though.

options: A mission from the Board of Directors?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What...?

options: If my guess is correct, the Board didn't give you these orders.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

options: Is it Mieszko Industries?
Is it Sun Shrubs Pharmaceuticals?
Is it Cloud Pharmaceuticals?
Of course, Rhodes Island is a threat to them.
But does it matter if some foreign company knows the truth?
I'm sure they have the power to silence Rhodes Island.
What they're really afraid of are the beasts sitting at the same table.
They're afraid of their fellow men.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So?

options: I'm guessing it won't be hard for you to kill me, huh?
What's the rush? You on some kind of flexible work schedule?
Why don't you take a seat and catch a breather?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Do you really understand what you're doing...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Even with this campaign knight in the way, I can—

options: No, you can't.
The spokesman personally oversaw our contract signing with our partners.
Malkiewicz has been very helpful.
Would you like to know, from a legal perspective, where Rhodes Island stands?
Right now, we're temporarily affiliated with the General Chamber of Commerce.
If you lay a finger on us, you're doing the same to the K.G.C.C.
Anyway, I think there's someone out there who's not about to let this chance pass by.
Of course, you people have a way to get around the law.
But under the veneer of civilization, there is a bloodbath that you can't get around.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: A call...?

options: Answer the phone, uh... Platinum, right?
It's for you.
Have a nice chat with civilization, ma'am.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Centaurea...?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: No need to be so shocked, Platinum.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I'm very glad you haven't killed Rhodes Island's leader yet.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Call it off. Your orders were mistaken. Those morons, jumping the gun. It is not up to them to give the Union orders without consulting the Board.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: And stop the madness that Area 0 is pulling on its so-called useless Infected. Rhodes Island has opened our eyes. Their lives still have meaning... They can yet create value.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: That's all.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You... You planned this?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: How did you do it?

options: You cozy up to some people, and you square up to others.
Wasn't that hard.
Most people think it's difficult to even bring ideas to their bosses.
What's actually difficult is figuring out how to cozy up and who to square up to.
Thankfully, I got a friend who's a good listener.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: So what will we do with Area 0...?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: We'll be working with too many uncertain factors if we let the two Infected knights make a big splash after all the uprisings the Infected have instigated.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: And if the public catches wind of the way Area 0 takes care of its Infected right now...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I suppose there are both upsides and downsides.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: We don't permit 'both upsides and downsides.' Whether it's good or bad, what we want is control over the matter.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I have other ways to handle this...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Just to be safe, I've already instructed the Armorless Union to take care of it.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Should I let you go, just like that?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You're an outsider who knows about the Armorless Union...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Don't be such a sore loser, Platinum. You're embarrassing yourself, you know?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! I've got something to ask you about transporting today's supplies—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm? Do you have a guest? I-I'm sorry...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: It's okay... Come in.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: An Armorless and a campaign knight are having tea together because of you, Doctor. You're really full of surprises.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um... Doctor, may I have a second? I need you to sign this...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (So that's Rhodes Island's leader... If I take her down now...)
Naturally, she is just entertaining the thought.
Even Gravel, who sits mere meters away from her, can feel not an ounce of hostility. After all, she is merely entertaining the thought.
Be that as it may, Platinum suddenly hesitates, before feeling relieved for her decision.
She is relieved that she did not carry out her mission.
In the blink of an eye, she senses a possibility in the petite Cautus.
If things escalate, will she actually be able to draw her arrow unscathed?
Or perhaps, before that—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm...? Miss? Is something the matter?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Never mind. Please excuse me.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'll send someone to fix the glass I broke. Time to go.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Doctor...{@nickname} of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, Gravel... Did something happen?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: We had a cup of tea together. That's all.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Platinum, ma'am... Here's what you wanted.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'm surprised you found it.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Right. We searched through the communications between Rhodes Island and the Adeptus, and we narrowed it down to this message with the clues we had.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: These are the true medical examination records of Operator Nearl... the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Radiant Knight... isn't Infected?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Welcome to the Kazimierz Major! It's your old buddy, Greatmouth Mob!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Thanks to Nightmare Knight's mistake, we're treated to today's matchup, the Blood Knight versus Nightmare Knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: With their terrifying auras, and might unmatched by any other, imagine the fight our mighty Blood Knight and the legendary Nightzmora have in store for us today!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Blood Knight and Nightmare had a fiery first encounter the other day! And now! They face each other in a formal match!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: There will be blood! There will be slaughter! Only the victor will get to bask in fame and glory. Let us welcome—our knights—for today's match—!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No knightclub, no sponsors. Good lord, why are you people leaving that huge pie on the table?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Somebody, make him a knightclub! You'll be rolling in all the dough!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: On the other side, we have the king of blood, Kazimierz's Blood-Red Chalice, the heartless victory machine, and deservedly, the very pinnacle!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: THE—BLOOOOOD KNIIIIGHT, DIKAAAAIIIOPOLIIIIIS!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: We meet again... Nightzmora.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Are you still searching for the shadows of the past?
